serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I was angry! My ex backstabbed me in the worst way possible and my mom still talked with her! She should be on my side, not on my enemy’s!
Blaubleim: I see you are very emotional about this. I already know more or less what happened between you and this young woman, but trust me, heartbreaks like that happen very often.
You: …
Blaubleim: I’m not telling you to be friends with your ex, but you must try to control your anger a little better.
